# Atlantis NDT

> Founder-led non-destructive testing (NDT) company: inspection services, ASNT SNT-TC-1A training, outsourced ASNT Level III consulting, and inspection software (Atlantis ERP, NDT reporting, digital twin reporting, Practical NDT simulator). Offices in Houston, Texas and Hyderabad, India; work is delivered remotely, online, or on-site at the client's facility.

Founder: Anoop Rayavarapu, ASNT NDT Level III in UT, RT, MT, PT and VT, with 11+ years of international NDT field experience. Atlantis provides ASNT NDT Level III consulting and ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based NDT training.

## Services
- [NDT Training](https://atlantisndt.com/training): ASNT SNT-TC-1A Level I and II courses (UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ET, PAUT, TOFD) and Level III exam preparation. 100% online and self-paced, with video lectures, PDF notes, quizzes, the Practical NDT simulator and an ASNT NDT Level III; the General, Specific and Practical exams are administered by our Level III. Under SNT-TC-1A the employer certifies, under its written practice. [Training FAQ](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-training-faq) · [SNT-TC-1A eligibility checker](https://atlantisndt.com/snt-tc-1a-eligibility) · [Register & Buy Now](https://portal.atlantisndt.com/course) (local price by country, pay by local card, course access opens automatically).
- [Inspection Services](https://atlantisndt.com/inspection): advanced and conventional NDT (PAUT, TOFD, AUT, corrosion mapping, eddy current, IRIS, guided wave, AE, ACFM, MFL, digital radiography, PEC, thermography, shearography; VT, PT, MT, UT, RT, hardness, PMI, ferrite, holiday and leak testing), asset integrity, risk-based inspection (API 580/581), technical staffing of certified inspectors (API, CSWIP, AWS CWI, AMPP, BGAS-CSWIP) and IRATA rope-access NDT technicians, commissioning and turnaround inspection. Led by ASNT Level III personnel; quotes per scope and region.
- [ASNT Level III Consulting](https://atlantisndt.com/consulting/ndt-consulting-level-iii): outsourced Level III, written practices, procedures, examinations and audit support. Topics: [NDT audit consulting](https://atlantisndt.com/consulting/ndt-audit-consulting) · [client and subcontractor approval audits](https://atlantisndt.com/consulting/subcontractor-approval-audits) · [SNT-TC-1A training programme setup](https://atlantisndt.com/consulting/snt-tc-1a-training-program-setup) · [NDT documentation requirements](https://atlantisndt.com/consulting/ndt-documentation-requirements) · [regulatory compliance](https://atlantisndt.com/consulting/ndt-regulatory-compliance) · [ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 17020 and 17025 for NDT](https://atlantisndt.com/consulting/iso-9001-17020-17025-ndt) (Atlantis NDT is certified to ISO 9001 and ISO 14001; it is not accredited to ISO/IEC 17020 or 17025).
- [NDT Written Practice Development](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-written-practice-development): SNT-TC-1A written practices, with a free template.
- [API 510, 570, 580 and 653 Inspection](https://atlantisndt.com/inspection-services): UT, PAUT, TOFD, RT, MT, PT and VT field inspection with Level III-reviewed reports; API 510, 570 and 653 programme support and API 580 risk-based inspection plans.
- [3D Scanning Services](https://atlantisndt.com/3d-scanning-services): LiDAR, photogrammetry and drone capture for as-built models (a scan records surfaces, not wall thickness).

## Software
- [Atlantis ERP](https://atlantisndt.com/erp): business management for inspection companies: technician certifications, equipment calibration, jobs, quoting, invoicing and NDT reports. [Free trial](https://atlantisndt.com/free-trial).
- [NDT Inspection Software](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-inspection-software): buyer's guide and product overview.
- [Best NDT Reporting Software](https://atlantisndt.com/best-ndt-reporting-software-2026): comparison of NDT reporting platforms.
- [Digital Twin Reporting](https://atlantisndt.com/digital-twin-reporting): inspection history on a navigable 3D asset model, with a labelled sample report.
- [Practical NDT](https://atlantisndt.com/practical-ndt): browser-based 3D practical simulator (12 method families, 12 workplaces, 33 lessons, 473 jobs), integrated with the Atlantis LMS and ERP.
